content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 7 promises "INDEMNIFICATION OF CONTRACTOR" in its caption but contains no indemnity language whatsoever — only the liability caps (7(a)), the consequential-damages exclusion (7(b)) and the attorneys' fees waiver (7(c)). A document-wide search for "indemn" returns only that heading. The sole IP protection is the bare non-infringement warranty at 5(c), which carries no defence, no indemnity and no remedies; 7(a)'s cap exception also dangles to Paragraph 9 (Independent Contractor).

**Classification:** deviation (walk-away territory — no Vendor IP indemnity).

**Cure (fallback level, two operations):**
1. New Paragraph 7(d): Contractor IP infringement indemnity, with the customary Company modification / combination / specification exclusions, procure–modify–replace remedies, a refund of fees paid if none is reasonably available, and a 3× annual fees super-cap.
2. Conformed 7(a) so the fees-paid cap excepts Paragraph 7(d) as well as Paragraph 9 — otherwise the base cap would swallow the super-cap.

We deliberately did not add a Company-side indemnity: none exists today, and inserting one to satisfy the preferred "Customer indemnity limited to…" element would weaken Clear Capital, which is why we targeted the all-Vendor-side fallback checklist.
